descriptors.concept_name: GST Foundation and Territorial Charging Mechanism
descriptors.definition: The charge of goods and services tax is triggered by the taxable event of supply, drawing its legislative power from the Constitution of India. Intra-State supplies attract central tax and state or union territory tax, whereas inter-State supplies attract integrated tax.
inclusion: Intra-State supplies of goods or services
Inter-State supplies of goods or services
exclusion: Supplies outside the charging provisions of the respective tax statutes
nearby_distinctions: Intra-State supply is governed by CGST and SGST/UTGST based on supplier location and place of supply, whereas inter-State supply attracts IGST.

descriptors.definition: Statutory definitions provide precise meanings for key terms such as goods, services, aggregate turnover, and reverse charge under the tax statutes. These definitions establish the operational boundaries and tax liabilities for various transactions and entities.
inclusion: Movable property, actionable claims, and specified growing crops
Value of taxable, exempt, export, and inter-state supplies for aggregate turnover
exclusion: Money and securities from the definitions of goods and services
nearby_distinctions: Aggregate turnover is computed on an all-India basis excluding specific central, state, and integrated taxes, unlike standard turnover measures.

descriptors.concept_name: Extent and Commencement of GST Law
descriptors.definition: The tax statutes extend to the entire territory of India, encompassing its territorial waters, seabed, subsoil, continental shelf, exclusive economic zone, and designated airspace. Each respective state or union territory enactment applies within its defined geographical boundaries.
instrument_references: Territorial Waters, Continental Shelf, Exclusive Economic Zone and other Maritime Zones Act, 1976
inclusion: Territory of India under Article 1 of the Constitution
Maritime zones including territorial waters and exclusive economic zones
exclusion: Territories outside the specified sovereign boundaries of India
nearby_distinctions: CGST and IGST extend pan-India, whereas UTGST applies exclusively to specific union territories without legislatures.

descriptors.concept_name: Levy and Collection of CGST and IGST
descriptors.definition: Central goods and services tax and integrated goods and services tax are levied on all intra-State and inter-State supplies respectively, subject to specified statutory exceptions and notification timelines. Tax liability may be shifted to the recipient under reverse charge mechanisms for specified categories of goods or services.
inclusion: All intra-State supplies of goods or services under CGST
All inter-State supplies of goods or services under IGST
exclusion: Un-denatured extra neutral alcohol or rectified spirit used for manufacturing alcoholic liquor
nearby_distinctions: Standard forward charge places liability on the supplier, whereas reverse charge shifts payment obligations directly to the recipient.

descriptors.definition: Eligible registered taxpayers with an aggregate turnover below a specified statutory threshold in the preceding financial year may opt to pay tax at a concessional rate calculated on their state or union territory turnover. This scheme restricts outward inter-State supplies and limits the supply of services alongside specific manufacturing or catering conditions.
terminology: Turnover in State or Union territory
inclusion: Registered persons with preceding financial year aggregate turnover meeting statutory limits
Manufacturers, restaurant service providers, and other eligible suppliers
exclusion: Taxpayers engaged in inter-State outward supplies of goods or services
Suppliers of non-taxable goods or services
nearby_distinctions: Composition levy offers a simplified tax calculation at lower rates based on state turnover instead of standard rates, subject to strict eligibility constraints.
